adaptive: Use PR head/merge-ref lineage for dependency-update assurance

maintenance: Treat evidence acquisition logic itself as a lifecycle component requiring calibration

safety_assurance: Require clean current combined-state execution before closing revalidation
learning_anti_recurrence: Persist SHA-type semantics in future CI probes: source head != merge ref != merge commit
falsifier: A clean reproduction showing actions/cache v6 or checkout v7 is the cause of failure after manifest duplication is removed
